about_the_game:
In an epic journey of betrayal and anger, the hero of the story, the leader of the Sacred Mountain Village, embarks on a perilous mission to take revenge on his close friend who betrayed him in his final moments during a failed attempt to obtain the bloodstained Devil's Space Thread Ball.

During this fruitless journey, the leader of the sacred village, inhabited by the people of the magical curses, works to develop his village, building an army and brave warriors to protect it from the impending evil planned by the Devil's Ball that has taken control of the hero’s companion and the despicable traitor.

Will the leader succeed in achieving his revenge, or will he perish along with his village in the face of this looming danger?

The Devil Ball game is an integrated game that combines Levels, which is a stage of platforms that you have to land on safely and take as much time as possible to collect coins, and the player's village, which is a strategic location. You have to use the gold coins you collected to upgrade the village and defenses to protect the village's spirit, which is a burning ball. Every ten minutes, an invasion of the village begins after a dimensional eye opens in the sky, from which devil balls appear that try to reach the village's spirit. You can also buy different playable characters, and each character has different features and different abilities.
